name: Relic of Oppression
description:
You found or purchased a weapon that was used by the Chthonic Subcommittee's Enforcers.

When you gain this ability, choose and gain one Nïrwe-made weapon without paying its Treasure cost. Whenever you attack with this weapon, +1d to the attack roll, then roll a d8. On a 1, you gain 1 Shadow.

Describe how you acquired the weapon.
